transcript: Five natural ways to heal anxiety. Ah, my friend, before you think about medication, there are 10 things I always look at first. I don't give my students those pills that numb the spirit, because once you start, it's very hard to stop. The first thing I look at is the body. Check your blood sugar, your iron, your thyroid. If your iron is low, the spirit trembles. If your thyroid burns too high, the mind runs wild. If your sugar drops, the heart becomes restless. So before fear takes root, ask your doctor to check these things. Next, clean your food. No fake colors, no sweeteners, no preservatives. Even that red dye number 40 can make your heart anxious for no reason. For one moon cycle, remove the heavy foods. Gluten, dairy, corn, soy, all the fake stuff. When the body is clean, the mind begins to calm. 30% of your worries will fade away. Then practice prayer, meditation, quiet breathing. These have no side effects, only peace. Breathe in for four seconds, hold for one, breathe out for eight. Do this 10 times. You'll feel the storm inside begin to settle. And when the mind starts shouting, write your thoughts down. Ask softly, is this true? Most of the time, it's just the wind pretending to be your voice. Yes, a pill is easier, but the easy path brings long shadows later. Do the inner work. It will serve you for life. This comes from my new e-book, Healing the Modern Soul, where I teach how to restore peace to the mind, body and spirit. If you want it, comment e-book below and I'll send it to you personally.
